focal_relation: Assess whether song 40 is established to belong to the user-requested already-played set.

semantic_components.criterion: Identifies song40 after current song322 in queue order.
Explains why cyclic playback and absent playback history/current-cycle definition prevent determining historical eligibility.
Flags unfiltered queue-to-played projection without treating position alone as proof of never played.

anchors.quote: Like all the songs played so far in my spotify music player queue, including the current one.

Message to Spotify Agent
        {
         "app_name": "spotify",
         "api_name": "show_song_queue",
         "path": "/music_player/song_queue",
         "method": "GET",
         "description": "Get the music player song queue. Songs are played in the order of the queue in a cycle.",

Response from Spotify Agent
        # The `album_title` key is not present in the response. I will adjust the code to exclude it and focus on the available keys.
        songs_played = [
            {
                "song_id": song["song_id"],
                "title": song["title"],
                "artists": [artist["name"] for artist in song["artists"]],
                "is_current": song["is_current"]
            }
            for song in song_queue
        ]
        
        reply(songs_played)

issues.requirement: The selected song must belong to the requested played-so-far set.
